SELECT a."DYNASTY" AS dynasty,
       ((ar."HIST_sign" + (ar.rating_profile->>'research_score')::numeric + (ar.rating_profile->>'cultural_score')::numeric)
        * (10 - CASE a.conserve_status WHEN 'Excellent' THEN 1 WHEN 'Good' THEN 3 WHEN 'Fair' THEN 5 WHEN 'Poor' THEN 7 WHEN 'Critical' THEN 10 END)) / 30.0 AS cpi_score,
       cm.budget_alloc AS budget_allocation,
       cm.budget_stat AS budget_status
FROM "ArtifactsCore" a
JOIN "ArtifactRatings" ar ON ar."ART_link" = a."ARTregID"
JOIN "ConditionAssessments" ca ON ca.art_exam = a."ARTregID"
JOIN "EnvironmentalReadingsCore" e ON e.case_link = ca.case_exam
JOIN "ConservationAndMaintenance" cm ON cm.monitor_link = e.monitor_code
WHERE a."DYNASTY" IS NOT NULL

WITH w AS (
  SELECT s."ART_link", s."ENVsense", s.env_handling_sensitivity AS d,
         (SELECT AVG(CASE v WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 5 WHEN 'High' THEN 10 END)
            FROM jsonb_each_text(s.env_handling_sensitivity->'environment') AS t(k, v)) AS erf
  FROM "SensitivityData" s
)
SELECT a."ARTregID" AS artifact_id, a.art_title AS artifact_name, w.erf AS erf_score,
       (SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_object_agg(k, v), '{}'::jsonb)
          FROM (SELECT 'environmental_sensitivity' AS k, w."ENVsense" AS v
                UNION ALL
                SELECT g.k2, g.v2 FROM jsonb_each(w.d) AS grp(gk, gv), jsonb_each_text(grp.gv) AS g(k2, v2)) x
         WHERE v = 'High') AS high_sensitivities
FROM w JOIN "ArtifactsCore" a ON a."ARTregID" = w."ART_link"
WHERE w.erf > 4
ORDER BY w.erf DESC

SELECT a."ARTregID" AS artifact_id, a.art_title AS title, r.risk_level, ar."HIST_sign" AS historical_significance,
       (ar.rating_profile->>'cultural_score')::numeric AS cultural_score
FROM "ArtifactsCore" a
JOIN "RiskAssessments" r ON r.art_concern = a."ARTregID"
JOIN "ArtifactRatings" ar ON ar."ART_link" = a."ARTregID"
WHERE r.risk_level IN ('High','Medium')
  AND ar."HIST_sign" > 8
  AND (ar.rating_profile->>'cultural_score')::numeric > 20

WITH sens AS (
  SELECT s."ART_link",
         s.env_handling_sensitivity->'environment'->>'light' AS light_s,
         (SELECT AVG(CASE v WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 5 WHEN 'High' THEN 10 END)
            FROM jsonb_each_text(s.env_handling_sensitivity->'environment') AS t(k, v)) AS erf
  FROM "SensitivityData" s
)
SELECT a."ARTregID" AS registration_id,
       sens.erf
       + (l.lux * CASE sens.light_s WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 5 WHEN 'High' THEN 10 END * l."visLxh") / 1000.0
       + 2 * ((a."ageYears" * sens.erf * power(e."RH" - 50, 2) * e."TEMPc") / 100000.0) AS tetl
FROM "ArtifactsCore" a
JOIN "RiskAssessments" r ON r.art_concern = a."ARTregID"
JOIN sens ON sens."ART_link" = a."ARTregID"
JOIN "ConditionAssessments" ca ON ca.art_exam = a."ARTregID"
JOIN "LightAndRadiationReadings" l ON l.rad_id = ca.light_link
JOIN "EnvironmentalReadingsCore" e ON e.monitor_code = l.env_link
WHERE r.risk_level = 'Medium'
ORDER BY tetl DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10

WITH c AS (
  SELECT a."ARTregID", a.art_title, a."DYNASTY",
         ((ar."HIST_sign" + (ar.rating_profile->>'research_score')::numeric + (ar.rating_profile->>'cultural_score')::numeric)
          * (10 - CASE a.conserve_status WHEN 'Excellent' THEN 1 WHEN 'Good' THEN 3 WHEN 'Fair' THEN 5 WHEN 'Poor' THEN 7 WHEN 'Critical' THEN 10 END)) / 30.0 AS cpi
  FROM "ArtifactsCore" a JOIN "ArtifactRatings" ar ON ar."ART_link" = a."ARTregID"
  WHERE a."DYNASTY" IN ('Ming','Qing')
)
SELECT "ARTregID" AS artifact_id, art_title AS title, "DYNASTY" AS dynasty, cpi AS cpi_score,
       CASE WHEN cpi > 7 THEN 'High Priority' WHEN cpi > 4 THEN 'Medium Priority' WHEN cpi <= 4 THEN 'Low Priority' END AS priority_level
FROM c ORDER BY cpi DESC NULLS LAST

WITH sens AS (
  SELECT s."ART_link",
         (SELECT AVG(CASE v WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 5 WHEN 'High' THEN 10 END)
            FROM jsonb_each_text(s.env_handling_sensitivity->'environment') AS t(k, v)) AS erf,
         (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM jsonb_each_text(s.env_handling_sensitivity->'environment') AS t(k, v) WHERE v = 'High') AS high_cnt
  FROM "SensitivityData" s
),
env AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (ca.art_exam) ca.art_exam, e."TEMPc", e."RH"
  FROM "ConditionAssessments" ca
  JOIN "EnvironmentalReadingsCore" e ON e.case_link = ca.case_exam
  ORDER BY ca.art_exam, e."readTS" DESC
)
SELECT a."ARTregID" AS artifact_id, a.art_title AS artifact_name,
       env."TEMPc" AS current_temperature, env."RH" AS current_humidity,
       COALESCE(sens.high_cnt, 0) AS high_sensitivity_count,
       CASE WHEN (a."ageYears" * sens.erf * power(env."RH" - 50, 2) * env."TEMPc") / 100000.0 > 5
             AND COALESCE(sens.high_cnt, 0) >= 2 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS accelerated_deterioration
FROM "ArtifactsCore" a
LEFT JOIN sens ON sens."ART_link" = a."ARTregID"
LEFT JOIN env ON env.art_exam = a."ARTregID"
ORDER BY a."ARTregID"

SELECT DISTINCT e.case_link AS showcase_id
FROM "EnvironmentalReadingsCore" e
WHERE e.case_link IS NOT NULL
  AND (e."tempVar24" > 1 OR e."RHvar" > 3)
ORDER BY e.case_link

WITH s AS (
  SELECT sc."caseID",
         (CASE WHEN sc.case_environment_profile->'physical_state'->>'seal_state' = 'Poor' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
        + CASE WHEN sc.case_environment_profile->'maintenance'->>'maint_status' = 'Overdue' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
        + CASE WHEN sc.case_environment_profile->'maintenance'->>'filter_status' = 'Replace Now' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
        + CASE WHEN sc.case_environment_profile->'maintenance'->>'silica_status' = 'Replace Now' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS issues,
         (sc.case_environment_profile->'physical_state'->>'leak_rate_per_day')::numeric AS leak
  FROM "Showcases" sc
)
SELECT DISTINCT s."caseID" AS showcase_id
FROM s
LEFT JOIN "EnvironmentalReadingsCore" e ON e.case_link = s."caseID"
WHERE 10 - ((e."tempVar24" + e."RHvar" / 5.0 + s.leak) / 3.0) < 5
   OR s.issues >= 3
ORDER BY s."caseID"
